Hi Rachel —

Thanks — congrats and thanks to the team. Wed 9/16 at 10am PT works great for me. I scanned the PDF and have two items I want to understand before signing:

1) Base + equity — the base looks correct but the equity vesting schedule in Section 3 reads as time-based only. Would the company consider a 1-year cliff followed by quarterly vesting (I prefer alignment with a standard schedule)?
2) PTO and parental leave — I’m planning for parental leave next year and want to confirm the parental leave language / top-up policy.

Preferred start date: Nov 1 to give more time for transition at my current employer.

If you can route the above as redlines to the right person before the call that would be helpful; otherwise we can discuss during the call. Also please send the DocuSign link when it’s ready — I prefer to review the final e-sign envelope rather than a static PDF.

Thanks,
